description: Cited Bitcoin coordination index. Not a live quote, ETF, derivatives, or chain analytics. Pin a layer with source. If ok is false, the index has no passage. Every plan searches both layers. Footnotes label domain (protocol, lightning, mining, tooling, security, nostr, governance). Record: IRC review logs, bitcoin-dev and cryptography mailing lists, GitHub PRs/issues/commits, Delving Bitcoin, Bitcointalk, attributed Bitcoin talk transcripts (source=transcripts), Satoshi communications, BIP text and BIP PRs/issues, release tags/signers, and Bitcoin Core source (consensus, policy, script, validation, net, mempool, miner). Price: CoinMetrics community PriceUSD (source=price), every daily close from 2010-07-18 through the last dated row, packed by ISO week. Curated: named primary texts (source=articles); SatoshiLabs SLIPs (source=slips); academic protocol/security papers (source=papers); open textbooks (source=textbooks: Learning Bitcoin from the Command Line, Karasavvas, minium, Elementary Bitcoin, Dorier C#, Book of Bitcoin commentary, Mastering Bitcoin 2e, Mastering Bitcoin 3e, Mastering LN, Mastering Taproot, bitcoin.org developer docs and RPC reference, Optech topics/newsletters); Nostr NIPs (source=nips); Stratum V2 spec (source=sv2); Lightning BOLTs, BLIPs, LNURL LUDs, and LSP spec (source=ln-spec); BDK, HWI, LDK, LND/CLN, miniscript, Sparrow Wallet docs (source=tooling); SeedSigner, Bitkey, and Foundation Passport docs (source=hw); specs, maps, research, and topic syntheses (source=synthesis).

query.description: Natural-language question or topic to retrieve cited passages for.

snapshot.description: If true, persist this result as a dated snapshot.

source.description: Optional pin to one corpus source (e.g. github, irc, mail, price, textbooks). Omit to search both layers.

when.description: Optional date pin YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps cites whose passage date starts with that prefix. Undated cites drop.

name: search
